pk/language.text: Demonstrates continual growth in understanding increasingly complex and varied vocabulary
Develops foundational skills to communicate effectively for a variety of purposes
Demonstrates interest in and appreciation of reading-related activities
Conveys meaning through drawing, letters, and words

pk/math.text: Demonstrates awareness of quantity, counting, and numeric competencies
Develops understanding of geometric shapes and spatial relationships
Demonstrates awareness of routines, predictable patterns, and attributes that can be measured
Develops foundational skills in learning to understand concepts of classification, data collection, organization, and description

pk/science.text: Demonstrates a basic awareness and use of scientific concepts
Develops foundational skills in learning and understanding about the world through exploration and investigation

pk/social.text: Develops self-awareness and sense of self
Develops foundational skills to support cooperation and prosocial behavior
Shows interest in, interacts with, and develops personal relationships with others
Develops a sense of belonging to family, community, and other groups
